text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival—a 
huge chance to interact with fans and 
showcase one's individuality!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The right side too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The left side too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: From behind too?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Straight to the top, if need be!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Everrrry single one of them is wearing 
glasses, aren't they~~!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it appears our police team for this 
game of Cops and Robbers... consists 
entirely of Umamusume wearing glasses.

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Mama, everyone's wearing glasses~. We're 
the matching twinsie team~♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Guh...! I can't tell them apart 
already...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Right... It looks like it's about time. 
Let's do our best, Team Glasses Police.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...This is bad. My plan to make an 
impression with an intellectual strategist 
routine using my 'glasses character' hook 
is...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, in a room full of glasses, 
I'll be completely buried by them—"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hm? "Full of glasses"?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —I've got an idea!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The event has begun. The bespectacled 
Umamusume of the "Police Team" all deploy 
in unison...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Good work, Rob Roy-san. That leaves 8 
thieves left. Leave the captured ones to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...! Now then, I shall 
continue my search!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. If they aim to free their comrade in 
this cell, it's likely they are lurking 
somewhere nearby.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, I've got data on the other team. 
The ones who seem good at hide-and-seek 
are~...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That girl with the glasses is amazing~! 
She feels so serious and intellectual!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Which girl with glasses...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Each of them is making their mark in their 
own way, but it seems people's impressions 
of them are somehow getting mixed 
together...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst all this, I suddenly realized 
something.
choice_data_list:
Royce, are you running around between your 
teammates...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's the thief team...! I'll go 
after them!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? My vision's blurry... Are my 
glasses slipping... or is it sweat?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Please wait!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That misalignment is caused by a bent nose 
pad! They warp easily when taking them on 
and off, or from impacts. I'll fix it 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Nn... "ABST"...! "MAST" triggered: "Dust 
cloud"...! Where is my... "glasses 
cloth"...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Those are plastic lenses, right? Don't 
wipe them dry, spray some water on first!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me. I always carry a 
maintenance kit with me."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my precious glasses— and 
for the sake of the team!☆

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, it doesn't slip out of place no 
matter how much I run... Thank you, Royce!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
All green, "visibility clear"...! 
Initiating "APPR", "capture" mode.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
What's with her? That girl with glasses... 
she sure knows an awful lot about them...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hasn't the police team gotten way 
stronger ever since that girl started 
moving... !?
choice_data_list:
Deliberately taking on a support role for 
the team...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(...Fufu, that's right. Your understanding 
is correct.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(With this many glasses-wearing characters 
gathered together... Every single 
personality just gets lumped under 
'glasses'.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(If that's the case, then I might as 
well...!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(I won't fear overlapping with anyone 
else— I'll break through as the ultimate 
glasses character...!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm really running out of breath! Anyone 
got anti-fog spray for my glasses!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If you lend me your glasses, I'll paint 
them carefully, quickly, and evenly before 
returning them!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's so shiny! Just having clear 
vision gets me super pumped~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It would be a pity to let poor visibility 
slow your stride. Now then, let us corner 
them!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Royce-san. Such love for 
glasses, such profound knowledge... Out of 
respect, I shall call you—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Glasses Meister. Yes, that is what we 
should call you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(! Ikuno-san, you're putting me in the 
spotlight...!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“—Leave it to me! I will protect 
everyone's glasses!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A fierce offensive! The bespectacled 
police Umamusume are driving up their 
arrest rate!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And the winner is—the Glasses Police 
Teeeaam!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO! Glasses! Meister! Glasses! 
Meister!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heh, hehehe...! These glasses aren't just 
for show!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the event ended, a long line had 
formed in front of her.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, I'll take a look one by one! 
When it comes to glasses, leave it to the 
Glasses Meister☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—No matter what kind of glasses-wearing 
Umamusume appears in the future, her 
individuality will never be overshadowed."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is, after all, the one and only 
Glasses Meister...!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Big Sis! Ehehe, I've been watching you 
from up here the whole~ time!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
You know what? I memorized what you look 
like, Big Sis! Even if there were 100 
girls with glasses, I'd definitely, 
def~initely know which one was you!
choice_data_list:
Those glasses are a one-of-a-kind trait, 
aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu♪ Please keep cheering for me, 
okay?"
